objective: Minimize durable governance state; prefer natural external owners, ephemeral carriers, owner-native evidence, pure decisions, stateless methods, and rebuildable indexes.

sunsetCondition.condition: Remove this ratchet after the same constraints are enforced by natural owners and three consecutive lifecycle audits show no governance abstraction growth or stale-carrier backlog requiring this local guard.

standards.name: OMG CMMN 1.1
standards.role: adaptive case continuity for genuinely non-predefined knowledge work

standards.name: Temporal
standards.role: durable workflow execution/recovery when executable workflow durability is actually required

standards.name: Kubernetes Job TTL / GC / finalizers
standards.role: negative lifecycle for finished execution carriers and owned dependents

standards.name: Git worktree
standards.role: ephemeral parallel working trees with explicit remove/prune lifecycle

standards.name: W3C PROV
standards.role: provenance relationships among entities, activities and agents

standards.name: SLSA Provenance
standards.role: content-linked provenance, builder identity, invocation and dependencies

standards.name: OPA
standards.role: decoupled policy decision point; enforcement stays with the caller

standards.name: MCP 2026-07-28
standards.role: stateless/self-contained protocol requests and capability discovery; analogy only for operator invocation

standards.name: MCP Registry
standards.role: discovery metadata pointing to packages/services rather than universal runtime ownership

standards.name: OCI Distribution
standards.role: content-addressed objects/descriptors and registry-as-distribution rather than semantic authority

Task.authority: Host continuity only; domain truth remains with natural owner
Task.admission: Persist only when work must survive conversation/process loss and cannot be reconstructed cheaply from a natural owner.
Task.retirement: Terminalize when locally complete or saturated, no positive value remains, and no explicit wake condition requires retained continuity.

Workspace.admission: Open only for an isolated mutable execution need.
Workspace.retirement: Close after active jobs are zero, required output is committed/preserved, dirty state is resolved or explicitly handed off, and no current semantic claimant requires the carrier.

Evidence.admission: Persist compact claim/provenance linkage when replay or verification requires it; keep raw bytes in their natural owner when possible.
Evidence.retirement: Derived analysis may be deleted when reproducible from retained sources; immutable attestations remain attached to the subject when required.

Gate.authority: Policy/domain decision rule; enforcement remains separate
Gate.admission: Prefer pure predicate; use OPA only when shared declarative policy distribution/evaluation is materially needed.
Gate.retirement: Delete or merge when it no longer changes admission, promotion, effect or completion decisions.

Lens.authority: Mature external discipline; lens output is derived analysis
Lens.admission: Active only after prospective unique decision/test/boundary value; 0 lenses remains valid.
Lens.retirement: MERGE/RESERVE/RETIRE when unique decision delta disappears.

Operator.admission: No new meta-operator unless it removes/subsumes an existing operator or proves a materially orthogonal transformation.
Operator.retirement: Delete/merge when equivalent composition exists or governance cost exceeds decision delta.

Registry.authority: Index only unless the external standard explicitly defines the registry as natural owner
Registry.admission: Prefer natural upstream registries; local registry must be rebuildable from source definitions.
Registry.retirement: Delete local registry when it only wraps a fixed dispatch map or duplicates upstream discovery.

growthRatchets.rule: Ceilings may shrink. Raising a ceiling requires a replacement/retirement in the same change plus prospective evidence; simple additive growth is rejected.

liveBaseline.interpretation: Diagnostic baseline only; these counts are not themselves deletion authority.
